mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CLASS_CODE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CLASS ( CLASS_CODE, OPERATOR_CODE, CATEGORY_CODE, NAME, PRICE, DESIRED_PRICE, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, OLD_ADDRESS, ADDRESS2, INGREDIENTS_INCLUDE, STATUS, REVIEW_SUM, STAR_RATING_AVG, VIEWS_CNT, SINGLE_INTRODUCE, INTRODUCE, FINISH_INTRODUCE, LAT, LNG, APPROVAL_STATUS, APPROVAL_MEMO, WRITE_DATE, REGISTER_STEP ) VALUES ( #{classCode}, #{authorCode}, (SELECT MIN(CATEGORY_CODE) FROM CATEGORY WHERE PARENTS_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL), '새 클래스', 0, 0, '-', '-', '-', '-', 'N', '준비중', 0, 0, 0, '작성 중', '작성 중', '작성 중', 0, 0, '작성중', NULL, SYSDATE, 'basic' )
mapper.select: SELECT OPERATOR_CODE FROM CREATOR WHERE OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CLASS_CODE, AUTHOR_CODE, CATEGORY_CODE, CATEGORY_NAME, CLASS_TITLE, SHORT_INTRODUCTION, CLASS_INTRODUCTION, MAIN_IMAGE_PATH, REGISTER_STEP FROM ( SELECT c.CLASS_CODE, c.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, (SELECT ct.NAME FROM CATEGORY ct WHERE ct.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS CATEGORY_NAME, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, c.SINGLE_INTRODUCE AS SHORT_INTRODUCTION, c.INTRODUCE AS CLASS_INTRODUCTION, c.REGISTER_STEP, ( SELECT MIN(ci.IMAGE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ci.SORT_ORDER, ci.CLASS_IMG_CODE) FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND ci.TYPE = '대표' ) AS MAIN_IMAGE_PATH FROM CLASS c WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.STATUS = '준비중' AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '작성중' AND c.APPROVAL_MEMO IS NULL ORDER BY c.WRITE_DATE DESC, c.CLASS_CODE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT c.CLASS_CODE, c.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, (SELECT ct.NAME FROM CATEGORY ct WHERE ct.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS CATEGORY_NAME, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, c.SINGLE_INTRODUCE AS SHORT_INTRODUCTION, c.INTRODUCE AS CLASS_INTRODUCTION, c.REGISTER_STEP, ( SELECT MIN(ci.IMAGE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ci.SORT_ORDER, ci.CLASS_IMG_CODE) FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND ci.TYPE = '대표' ) AS MAIN_IMAGE_PATH FROM CLASS c WHERE c.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE CLASS c SET c.CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode}, c.NAME = #{classTitle}, c.SINGLE_INTRODUCE = #{shortIntroduction}, c.INTRODUCE = #{classIntroduction}, c.WRITE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE c.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.STATUS = '준비중' AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('작성중', '수정중') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CATEGORY ct WHERE ct.CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode} AND ct.PARENTS_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT c.CLASS_CODE, c.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, c.ZIPCODE, c.ADDRESS, c.OLD_ADDRESS, c.ADDRESS2 AS DETAIL_ADDRESS, c.LAT AS LATITUDE, c.LNG AS LONGITUDE FROM CLASS c WHERE c.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE CLASS SET ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, ADDRESS = #{address}, OLD_ADDRESS = #{oldAddress}, ADDRESS2 = #{detailAddress}, LAT = #{latitude}, LNG = #{longitude}, WRITE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND STATUS = '준비중' AND APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('작성중', '수정중')

UPDATE CLASS SET ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, ADDRESS = #{address}, OLD_ADDRESS = #{oldAddress}, ADDRESS2 = #{detailAddress}, LAT = #{latitude}, LNG = #{longitude} WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND STATUS IN ('모집중', '준비중') AND APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인'
mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_CODE, NAME FROM CATEGORY WHERE PARENTS_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PARENTS_CATEGORY, CATEGORY_CODE

SELECT c.CLASS_CODE, c.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, 'ONCE' AS SCHEDULE_TYPE, ( SELECT MIN(r.OPERATION_START_DATE) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUIT_START_DATE, ( SELECT MAX(r.OPERATION_END_DATE) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUIT_END_DATE, c.PRICE AS REGULAR_PRICE, c.DESIRED_PRICE, NVL(( SELECT MIN(s.MIN_PEOPLE) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY s.CLASS_DATE, s.START_TIME, s.SCHEDULE_CODE ) FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ), 2) AS MIN_PEOPLE, NVL(( SELECT MIN(s.MAX_PEOPLE) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY s.CLASS_DATE, s.START_TIME, s.SCHEDULE_CODE ) FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ), 6) AS MAX_PEOPLE, CASE WHEN c.INGREDIENTS_INCLUDE = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MATERIAL_INCLUDED FROM CLASS c WHERE c.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}
mapper.update:
UPDATE CLASS SET PRICE = #{regularPrice}, DESIRED_PRICE = #{desiredPrice}, WRITE_DATE = SYSDATE, INGREDIENTS_INCLUDE =
'Y' 'N'
WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND STATUS = '준비중' AND APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('작성중', '수정중')

UPDATE CLASS SET PRICE = #{regularPrice}, DESIRED_PRICE = #{desiredPrice}, INGREDIENTS_INCLUDE =
'Y' 'N'
WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND STATUS IN ('모집중', '준비중') AND APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인'
mapper.select: SELECT c.CLASS_CODE, c.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, c.FINISH_INTRODUCE AS RESULT_DESCRIPTION FROM CLASS c WHERE c.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}
SELECT INGREDIENTS FROM DETAIL_INFO WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND CHARACTER = '장점' ORDER BY DETAIL_INFO_CODE
SELECT INGREDIENTS FROM DETAIL_INFO WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND CHARACTER = '추천' ORDER BY DETAIL_INFO_CODE
SELECT CLASS_OFFERING_CODE FROM CLASS_OFFERING_MAP WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} ORDER BY CLASS_OFFERING_CODE
SELECT ADDITIONAL_INFO_CONTENT FROM CLASS_ADDITIONAL_INFO WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} ORDER BY ADDITIONAL_INFO_CODE
SELECT TAG_NAME FROM TAG WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} ORDER BY TAG_CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE CLASS SET FINISH_INTRODUCE = #{resultDescription}, WRITE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND STATUS = '준비중' AND APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('작성중', '수정중')
mapper.select: SELECT CLASS_MATERIAL_CODE AS MATERIAL_CODE, CLASS_CODE, MATERIAL_NAME, MATERIAL_CONTENT FROM CLASS_MATERIAL WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} ORDER BY CLASS_MATERIAL_CODE
SELECT CLASS_OFFERING_CODE AS OFFERING_CODE, OFFERING_NAME FROM CLASS_OFFERING WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CLASS_OFFERING_CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE CLASS SET REGISTER_STEP = #{step}, WRITE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND STATUS = '준비중' AND APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('작성중', '수정중')

UPDATE CLASS SET APPROVAL_STATUS = '수정중', STATUS = '준비중', REGISTER_STEP = 'basic', WRITE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND STATUS = '대기중' AND APPROVAL_STATUS = '반려'

UPDATE CLASS SET APPROVAL_STATUS = #{status}, APPROVAL_MEMO = NULL, WRITE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND STATUS = '준비중' AND APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('작성중', '수정중')
mapper.select: SELECT c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, ct.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, c.ADDRESS, ( SELECT MIN(ci.IMAGE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ci.SORT_ORDER, ci.CLASS_IMG_CODE) FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND ci.TYPE = '대표' ) AS THUMBNAIL_PATH, c.APPROVAL_STATUS AS CLASS_STATUS, c.WRITE_DATE AS REGISTERED_DATE, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(s.CLASS_DATE), 'YYYY.MM.DD') || '부터 ' || COUNT(*) || '개 일정' FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ) AS SCHEDULE_SUMMARY, c.DESIRED_PRICE FROM CLASS c JOIN CATEGORY ct ON ct.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE WHERE c.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('대기', '승인', '반려')
